name: hazel_weir_central_procedural_graph
description: Central Procedural Graph synthesized from Hazel Weir baseline + Kaggle ladder loss forensics (Episode 109577172 bankruptcy audit and 109205361 shop execution audit).

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, and oracle price drop signals.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Blocks capital expenditure and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation to prevent the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade.

nodes.name: Shed Headroom Relief
nodes.description: Prevents silent 100/100 harvest discards by clearing low-margin inventory before workers deliver crops.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Preemptively matches unlocked town shop demand surges (Carrots, Tomatoes, Eggs) to capture 2x-3x price premiums.

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Reads 96-step TTM forecast to dump sensitive commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) immediately before opponent market gluts collapse prices.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes field routines (planting, watering, feeding livestock, harvesting) using available action slots.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases (BUY_SEED, BUY_ANIMAL, BUY_LAND, redundant HIRE); enforce emergency sales of non-feed inventory at hour >= 20; schedule worker harvest drop-offs before hour 21.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 2); do not rely solely on low-value fertilizer sales to cover payroll deficits.

attributes.guidance: Evict pending buy orders to free order slots; schedule batch sale of highest-volume holdings with price >= 0.15 * base_price.
attributes.pitfalls: Never evict feed Wheat when animals are hungry; ensure shed capacity is cleared before step 720 terminal drop.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and money >= 1200.0 and day between 3 and 25
attributes.guidance: Allocate up to 2 market slots for shop-demanded seeds (Carrots, Tomatoes); prioritize selling matured shop crops into active shop windows.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not buy shop seeds if shed is over 90 capacity or if cash is needed for wage reserve.

attributes.guidance: Preempt lowest-margin open orders; place batch sell of held commodity before market price drops below marginal cost.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not sell into already collapsed $1.00 markets unless shed is in immediate danger of overflowing.

attributes.guidance: Dispatch idle hands to weeds, feeding, watering, and harvest collection in priority order.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not leave crops unwatered for consecutive turns; ensure hands drop carried items before end of turn 717.
